Implemented a clean-room Go reimplementation of the probed CLI in [main.go](/workspace/main.go), [config.go](/workspace/config.go), [imports.go](/workspace/imports.go), [packageinfo.go](/workspace/packageinfo.go), and [processor.go](/workspace/processor.go). Probe fixtures are still in `/workspace/tmp_*` if you want to inspect the comparison cases.
